limits: Platform cumulative 'games created for jams' is not a census of unique game sellers or positive-price commercial projects.
Jam submissions and votes may include repeat creators, teams, overlapping projects and multiple rating events.
The jam report says 482 submitted entries but 483 rated entries; neither number is silently corrected.
A positive rating, submission or jam participation is not a buyer, game unit sold or profit.
No experiment connects jam activity to subsequent paid game purchases, so causal monetization remains unknown.
